description: This file defines the HttpKernel class for the OrangeHRM installer's framework, extending Symfony's HttpKernel. It handles setting up the dependency injection container, logging, routing, session management, and request handling for the installer application.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: A custom HTTP kernel class for the installer framework extending Symfony's HttpKernel, managing request processing, routing, sessions, and logging.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HttpKernel, setting environment and debug mode, configuring dependency injection, and setting up core services.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Registers core services like request stack, router context, event dispatcher, controller resolver, and argument resolver into the container.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Sets up the logger with appropriate log file path and level based on the debug mode and log file writability.

methods.name: isLogFileWritable
methods.description: Checks if the log file is writable by attempting to append to it.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing by loading route definitions from configuration and adding route event listeners.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads route definitions from a YAML configuration file.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures session storage based on write permissions and system check, throwing exception if not writable.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and configures a session object with proper options and storage handler.

methods.name: configureSubscribers
methods.description: Registers global event subscribers like exception handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Prepares and handles an incoming request, configuring routing, session, and subscribers.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Returns whether debug mode is enabled.
